data.gender_notes: Jagmohan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who has a radiant mind
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit words 'Jagat' meaning world and 'Mohan' meaning enchanting, Jagmohan signifies one who has a radiant mind. The name Jagmohan carries the meaning “One who has a radiant mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jagmohan usually hope their child will grow to embody one who has a radiant mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing spiritual enlightenment and inner beauty.
data.etymology: Jagmohan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who has a radiant mind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagmohan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jagmohan has been significantly prominent in the Indian subcontinent for centuries, with mentions in various literary works and historical records. It is also the popular name of an important administrative building in the Golden Temple complex in Amritsar. The name embodies the vibrant and transcendent spirit of India, evoking a sense of enchantment, wisdom, and connection to the world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Jagmohan signifies an individual who is not only curious about the workings of the world but also seeks to understand it at a deeper level. The 'Jagat' or worldly consciousness is balanced by the 'Mohan', or the enchanting inner wisdom. It inspires one to explore the intricacies of existence, seeking enlightenment and inner peace while remaining grounded in the reality of the world. Jagmohan thus symbolizes a spiritual journey of inward exploration and outward understanding, making it a profound and meaningful name for any individual.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jagmohan: Householder of the World. Vibrant consciousness illuminating the material world. Symbolic and spiritual meaning behind the Hindu name "Jagmohan": Jagmohan signifies the householder of the world. This name is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Jagat' meaning the world and 'Mohan' meaning to attract or to allure. The name symbolizes an individual who carries the consciousness of the world within them, illuminating and transforming the material world with their vibrant awareness. Jagmohan is a reminder of the divine responsibility we hold as inhabitants of this earth to nurture and uplift the world around us, while remaining deeply connected to the inner Self.

vedic_reference.note: Not from Vedas, but a common name in India.

historical_references.reference: Jagmohan was a prominent Mughal nobleman in the late 16th and early 17th centuries. He served under Emperor Akbar and was one of the nine gems of his court, a title given to the most trusted and influential advisors. Jagmohan played a significant role in the administration of the Mughal empire, overseeing the provinces of Malwa and Gujarat.

Another Jagmohan, a renowned Hindu scholar, lived in the late 18th and early 19th centuries in Bengal. He was a Sanskrit scholar, philosopher, and poet. Jagmohan made significant contributions to the field of Bengali literature, translating several Sanskrit texts into Bengali and writing original works.
